_doc: Schema reference for config.json. Copy this file to config.json and edit, or run `npm run setup`. Keys prefixed with `_` are documentation; the validator ignores unknown keys but they're conventionally `_comment`/`_doc`. Set any optional service or `riot`/`minecraftServers` to null/[] to disable that project's UI gracefully.

postgres._comment: Three scoped roles map to: workshop (general read/write, used by the web app), soulseek_ingest (the music staging daemon), challenge_poller (the LoL challenges scraper). The setup CLI generates random passwords on first run.

paths._comment: musicDirectory is the root for /projects/barfoo and the soulseek staging area (which writes to <musicDirectory>/.slskd-downloads). brainfuckRepo defaults to vendor/brainfuck-genetic (the git submodule); pythonBin defaults to <brainfuckRepo>/.venv/bin/python.

services._comment: Each service is null until configured. The /setup page in the running app provides a per-service editor with `Test connection` buttons.
services._finnhub_comment: Optional fallback quote source for /projects/paper-trading. The primary source is yahoo-finance2 (no key needed); finnhub is only hit when yahoo errors or returns nothing. Get a free key at finnhub.io. Leave null to disable the fallback.

_setupToken_comment: Generated by `npm run setup`. Required to PATCH /api/config from the in-app /setup page. If null, all writes are denied — recover by editing config.json directly.
